artifacts.notes: Inspected remotely. The record identifies 11Q11 as a Hebrew square-script parchment manuscript from Qumran Cave 11, assigns a Herodian period, lists its four scientific-number/plate groups, and cites García Martínez, Tigchelaar, and van der Woude, DJD 23 (1998), pp. 181–205. Its image links are finding aids, not distributable source artifacts or an adjudicated column reconstruction.
artifacts.rights_basis: The IAA terms identify the website, text, and images as copyrighted and all rights reserved, permitting only single copies for private use absent prior written permission. No bytes or images are redistributed by Triptych.

edition.notes: Catalog record inspected 2026-07-28. It controls manuscript identity, material description, broad paleographic period, image inventory, and official-publication bibliography, not the wording, reconstruction, translation, or line numbering of the manuscript.

edition.title: 11Q11 manuscript catalog record

work.description: A fragmentary Hebrew collection of apocryphal psalmic materials from Cave 11. Edition records must preserve column, line, fragment, lacuna, attribution, and reconstruction boundaries; the manuscript identity does not establish a single original occasion or complete ritual sequence.
